title: Natural bilinear maps on formal kernel pieces before the module laws
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\mathcal I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $F=(\mathcal F_r)_{r\geq 1}$ a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $B_m=\mathcal I^m/\mathcal I^{m+1}$, $K_0=\mathcal F_1$, $K_n=\operatorname{Ker}(\mathcal F_{n+1}\to\mathcal F_n)$ for $n>0$, and let $\pi_m$ and $\iota_n$ be the projections and inclusions [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces]. There exist $\mathcal O_X(U)$-bilinear maps $\mu_{m,n,U}:B_m(U)\times K_n(U)\to K_{m+n}(U)$ for all $m,n\geq0$ and opens $U$, compatible with restriction. For every $a\in\mathcal I^m(U)$, $x\in K_n(U)$ and $t\in\mathcal F_{m+n+1}(U)$ reducing to $\iota_n(x)$ in $\mathcal F_{n+1}(U)$, $\iota_{m+n}(\mu_{m,n,U}(\pi_m(a),x))=a t$. No graded algebra structure, associativity or unit law is required or asserted.

source.place: Lemma 087Z (lemma-finite-over-rees-algebra), its associated graded construction, and Section 0EHN; expanded local-lift argument. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087Z and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EHN.

proof.text: For each fixed m,n,U,a,x, choose the unique output section of the product-section lemma. Its full local representative equations determine the choice uniquely. Restriction preserves these equations by presheaf functoriality, so uniqueness proves restriction compatibility. Taking the identity restriction proves the formula for any given global representative and lift.

Reuse the proved private formal_transition_epi and local_lifts_three helpers from FormalKernelBilinearActionAssociative through a proof-only import all. These helpers establish epimorphic formal transitions and simultaneous local lifts of three sections, without using the associativity theorem itself. Coefficient projections are cokernel projections and also epis.

Prove the four linearity identities locally. For left additivity use two coefficient lifts and one kernel lift; for right additivity use one coefficient lift and two kernel lifts. Their sums lift the summed inputs. For scalar laws restrict the scalar and multiply the corresponding lift by it. Apply the product formula, linearity of the component maps and scalar distributivity, associativity and commutativity. The existing private kernel_inclusion_injective helper from FormalKernelBilinearActionAssociative proves injectivity on sections, so these calculations prove the local identities. Sheaf separation proves each identity on U, including the empty cover. LinearMap.mk₂ packages them into bilinear maps; the previously proved naturality and representative formula finish.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 087Z and Section 0EHN: A2 separates the uniquely characterized product section from bilinearity and naturality. All assembly steps are proved in Lean; the fixed-section construction remains the one new item. Repair: reuse the four private lifting and inclusion helpers from FormalKernelBilinearActionAssociative with import all; no associativity theorem is applied and no helper is reproved.

lean.statement:
theorem formalKernel_bilinear_action_exists {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X I) :
    ∃ act : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
      (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I m).val.obj (op U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
        (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
          (formalKernelPiece F (m + n)).val.obj (op U),
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (U V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U)
        (a : (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I m).val.obj (op U))
        (x : (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U)),
      (formalKernelPiece F (m + n)).val.map (homOfLE h).op (act m n U a x) =
        act m n V ((formalAssociatedGradedPiece I m).val.map (homOfLE h).op a)
          ((formalKernelPiece F n).val.map (homOfLE h).op x)) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
          (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
          (x : (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U))
          (t : (F.obj.obj (op (m + n))).val.obj (op U)),
          (F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_left n m)).op).val.app (op U) t =
            (formalKernelι F n).val.app (op U) x →
          (formalKernelι F (m + n)).val.app (op U)
            (act m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a) x) =
              (@id Γ(X, U)
                ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) • t)
